title: cytisus supranubius
intro: Cytisus supranubius, commonly known as Tree Genista or Montpelier Broom, is a flowering plant species within the pea family Fabaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, as well as its ability to aid in wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Cytisus supranubius are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant and immunomodulatory effects. Further research is needed to fully understand the therapeutic potential of Cytisus supranubius and its bioactive constituents.
